A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the first large-scale dataset for hashtag-oriented spam detection and analysis in tweets.
we present a novel and effective approach to annotate a large number of tweets for hashtag-oriented spam, and we provide a large-scale and high-quality dataset for hashtag-oriented spam analysis.
the HSpam-14 dataset is useful for hashtag-oriented spam detection, and the observations made from HSpam14 would be beneficial for future research on hashtag-oriented spam detection in tweets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hashtags can be abused for spamming purposes and the spamming behaviors are different from the spamming behaviors in email/web.
hashtags can be a powerful tool for spammers to promote their spamming content.
the HSpam dataset can be used for spam research in tweets, particularly for hashtag-oriented spam.
